mapper.select:
SELECT id, age_group_code, age_group_label, survey_year, avg_household_head_age, household_distribution_pct, avg_income, median_income, avg_asset, median_asset, avg_debt, median_debt, avg_net_worth, median_net_worth, avg_debt_repayment, median_debt_repayment
FROM kosis_age_group_net_worth
WHERE age_group_label = #{ageGroupLabel}
ORDER BY survey_year DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT k.id, k.age_group_code, k.age_group_label, k.survey_year, k.avg_household_head_age, k.household_distribution_pct, k.avg_income, k.median_income, k.avg_asset, k.median_asset, k.avg_debt, k.median_debt, k.avg_net_worth, k.median_net_worth, k.avg_debt_repayment, k.median_debt_repayment
FROM kosis_age_group_net_worth k INNER JOIN ( SELECT age_group_label, MAX(survey_year) AS max_year FROM kosis_age_group_net_worth WHERE age_group_label != '전체' GROUP BY age_group_label ) latest ON k.age_group_label = latest.age_group_label AND k.survey_year = latest.max_year
ORDER BY k.age_group_code ASC
